title: Casten, Lieu propose whistleblower program for prediction market insider trading
summary: Reps. Sean Casten (D-Ill.) and Ted Lieu (D-Calif.) introduced new legislation Friday to regulate prediction markets and prevent insider trading, allowing whistleblowers to come forward and report wrongdoing.
